title: ltm user config
description: Per-user settings for ltm, read from $LTM_CONFIG, else %APPDATA%\ltm\config.yaml on Windows, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ltm/config.yaml, else ~/.config/ltm/config.yaml. It names the Banks this user has checked out and says which apply to a Consumer repo.

banks.description: Map each Bank name to its local checkout. Rules, default, and a Consumer repo's .ltm.yaml refer to Banks by these names.

path.description: Give the Bank's local checkout, the directory holding memory-bank.yaml. A leading ~/ expands to the home directory, and a relative path resolves against this file's directory.

url.description: Give the Bank's git remote. ltm connect prints it, and ltm mcp clones from it.

rules.description: Map Consumer repos to Banks by their origin's <host>/<org>/<repo>. Every matching rule applies, in order.

match.description: Give a / separated pattern with the same number of segments as <host>/<org>/<repo>, where * matches any one segment. A subgroup identity has more segments, such as gitlab.com/grp/sub/repo, so gitlab.com/grp/*/* matches repos in subgroups of grp. A lone * matches every repo.

default.description: Name the Bank from banks to use when no .ltm.yaml exists and no rule matches.
